headline: Türkiye Services Confidence Falls in October as Retail and Construction Rise
summary: Türkiye's seasonally adjusted confidence index declined in the services sector during October, while sentiment improved in the retail trade and construction sectors.
why: Turkey's economic sentiment indicators provide critical insights into domestic demand and sectoral health for emerging market investors.

impacts.name: Turkish Services
impacts.why: Lower service sector confidence indicates a potential slowdown in domestic service activity.
